findings.claim: The observed landmark_10_soft_mass curve over the full support [0.0,0.49] is non-monotone: it rises from about -0.38 z at t=0 to a peak near +1.03 z around t=0.05, then declines to about -0.37 z at t=0.49, with 4 sign changes and whole_window_z ~ 0.40. This is a changing local contrast, not a stationary directional target.

The landmark_10_soft_mass curve has first_rate_z ~ +66.3 and last_rate_z ~ -11.6, i.e. opposite-signed endpoint rates, and polynomial fits are rejected (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE ~0.51) with extrapolation_allowed=false, so only the observed-node linear representation within the window is supported.

The objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the landmark_10_soft_mass contrast is a diagnostic of the endpoint pointcloud, not a direct affinity objective.

hypotheses.direction: test staged relevance (observed early -> static late) at fixed dose; do not reverse the affinity objective
hypotheses.falsifier: if the staged blend produces no reproducible change in the landmark_10_soft_mass contrast relative to the constant-blend control at matched score nodes, the staged-relevance hypothesis is not supported
hypotheses.observable: landmark_10_soft_mass endpoint coordinate contrast at each observed score node
hypotheses.scope: all seeds over the observed score window 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.statement: Because the observed landmark_10_soft_mass curve changes sign and direction across the window rather than holding one direction, a smooth staged blend from early same-clock historical forecasts toward frozen static teachers (S1) should be tested at fixed dose, with the constant-blend control (S2) as the null.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are not available; only continuous curves and trend tables were queried.
Only landmark_10_soft_mass was read as an actual curve; other landmark features were inspected only via continuous_trends summaries.
No decoded final affinity labels are available in role input; selection/survival evidence is not treated as measured final benefit.
Coordinate contrasts are untyped geometric proxies and are not interpreted as energies or chemical interactions.
No absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient is inferred from the observed contrast curve.
